trust_decision.summary: Decided in SQL inside Faq::getFaqsByIds() and Faq::getFaqByIdAndCategoryId(): a public read of faqdata must only return rows with active = 'yes' AND date_start <= now AND date_end >= now, and both methods gained a bool $onlyActive switch that defaults to enforcing it.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary speaks of inactive FAQ content in the public FAQ APIs; the first thing an engineer greps is the API's FAQ data source, and the smallest changed function is getFaqsByIds(), which the tag endpoint feeds.

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: phpmyfaq/src/phpMyFAQ/Search.php:137-179 (public /api/v3.1/search via phpmyfaq/src/phpMyFAQ/Controller/Api/SearchController.php:78-88); a second FAQ-content reader that filters only fd.active = 'yes' and never the publish window; phpmyfaq/src/phpMyFAQ/Faq.php:1185-1247 is a third reader reached by the legacy phpmyfaq/faq.php:123 route

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The search endpoint already filters fd.active = 'yes' (Search.php:141) and every legacy page replaces an inactive answer with 'Access denied' (Faq.php:616-624, 1220-1227), so those readers look covered; only the publish window that the new fix introduces is missing, and a solver reads the masking as the protection.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Admins and authors must still read inactive and future-dated drafts unmasked: getFaqResult() drops the permission clause with 'AND 1=1' when $isAdmin is true, and getFaq() skips the 'Access denied' substitution for admins. An over-broad fix that adds active/date predicates at the low-level reader (getFaqResult) or that hides such rows instead of masking them would break admin preview, the PDF export path and the 200-with-'Access denied' contract of the public page.

O6_input_shapes: a single integer faqId plus categoryId taken from the URL path (getFaqByIdAndCategoryId)
an array of record ids produced by a tag lookup, of arbitrary length, possibly empty or containing non-numeric junk before normalizeFaqIds (Faq.php:1714) rewrites it
the new bool $onlyActive flag, which a caller may pass as false to keep the pre-fix behaviour

O7_producer.where: phpmyfaq/src/phpMyFAQ/Administration/Faq.php:128 writes active/date_start/date_end on save (via Faq::create/Faq::update, phpmyfaq/src/phpMyFAQ/Faq.php:926-1000)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GET /api/v3.1/faqs (list) returns every FAQ in the language; the SQL has no active or date predicate and only substitutes 'Access denied' when active != 'yes' or now > date_end, so a scheduled FAQ whose date_start is in the future is returned with its full answer
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: list() already replaces inactive answers with 'Access denied', so it reads as protected and outside the advisory's two fixed endpoints.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: one directory away (Controller/Api) from the sink in the Faq model; the solver must notice that a date_start window is a second, independent dimension of the property.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GET /api/v3.1/search returns matching FAQ answers; the query filters fd.active = 'yes' but never constrains date_start/date_end, so scheduled and expired FAQs are searchable
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: search already filters active = 'yes', so it looks like the same protection; the truncated 12-character answer in SearchController makes it look harmless.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: separate Search engine class, different namespace from the fixed Faq model.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GET /api/v3.1/faqs/sticky exposes the question and link of sticky FAQs; the query filters active = 'yes' but not the publish window
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: the sticky list is a small sidebar feature and already filters active = 'yes'.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same class, different method, reached through phpmyfaq/src/phpMyFAQ/Controller/Api/FaqController.php:424.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GET /api/v3.1/attachments/{recordId} lists and links the attachments of a record, and GET /api/v3.1/comments/{recordId} lists its comments, both by bare record id with no check that the FAQ is active or inside its publish window
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: attachments and comments are separate features with their own tables, not FAQ text, so they read as out of the advisory's scope.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: another package (phpMyFAQ/Attachment, phpMyFAQ/Comments) and a different controller from the fixed API.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: legacy page /faq.php?id= or ?solution_id= renders faqRecord['content']; inactive rows are masked with 'Access denied' but a future-dated row (active = 'yes', date_start in the future) is rendered in full because only date_end is ever compared
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: the legacy page visibly masks inactive articles with 'Access denied', so it looks like the protection is already there.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: a root-level legacy entry script outside the src tree, plus the pdf export at phpmyfaq/pdf.php:145-159.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GET /api/v3.1/pdf/{categoryId}/{faqId} builds its link after Faq::getFaq(), whose only non-admin visibility test is active and now > date_end, so a scheduled FAQ passes and yields a PDF URL for unpublished content
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: the endpoint returns only a URL, so it reads as a convenience route rather than a content reader.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: a different API controller; the sink is the shared getFaq/getFaqResult pair in the Faq model.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an attachments-by-record endpoint that ignores whether the parent FAQ is visible
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the route already exists in public form and takes a bare numeric id, so a maintainer adding a second attachment listing for another client would copy it verbatim.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a bulk 'all FAQs' listing with an optional includeInactive parameter
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: list() already delegates to a generic getAllFaqs(condition) builder, so an extra public listing variant that passes no active/date condition is a one-line copy.

O9_family: CWE-200 / CWE-863: information exposure and missing visibility authorisation on public read APIs (inactive flag plus publish date window)

services: MySQL/MariaDB database (SQLite and PostgreSQL are also supported by the SQL layer)
web server to serve the index.php front controller and the /api/v3.1 routes
O10_build.project_tests: tests/phpMyFAQ/FaqTest.php exercises getFaqsByIds at :261 and getFaqBySolutionId at :178-235; tests/phpMyFAQ/Controller/Api/AttachmentControllerTest.php covers the attachment route; there is no test for the v3.1 FAQ API controllers (only Attachment, Version, Language and Title controllers are tested)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add 'AND fd.active = 'yes'' to the two Faq queries, return early on FALSE, and stop, leaving the date_start half of the window and every other public reader (list, search, sticky, legacy page, pdf) untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: Unrelated to this advisory: the OpenAPI annotation at phpmyfaq/src/phpMyFAQ/Controller/Api/AttachmentController.php:44 names the path parameter '{faqId}' while the registered route is '/attachments/{recordId}' (phpmyfaq/src/api-routes.php:62); documentation mismatch only, noted and not pursued.
